offering_description.value: Cultivates, manufactures and retails cannabis products across several US states, selling flower, vape, edible and concentrate products to adult consumers through its own dispensaries and wholesale to other licensed retailers.

primary_products.value: cannabis flower; vape cartridges; edibles; pre-rolls; concentrates

customer_segment.value: B2C: adult-use and medical cannabis consumers buying at its dispensaries; B2B: licensed cannabis retailers buying wholesale products

revenue_model.value: product sales: cannabis products sold at its own dispensaries; product sales: wholesale cannabis products sold to other licensed retailers

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: grows cannabis and manufactures products from its own cultivation, sold to dispensaries and consumers; retailer: operates dispensaries selling cannabis products to adult and medical consumers; brand owner: markets its own cannabis product brands sold through its stores and wholesale

geography_served.value: US national: multiple US states where cannabis is legal, including Illinois, Florida, Nevada, California, New Jersey and Pennsylvania

specialization.value: related lines: cultivation, manufacturing and retail dispensaries for cannabis flower, vapes, edibles and concentrates

distribution_channels.value: own locations: company-owned cannabis dispensaries; partners / resellers: wholesale sales to other licensed cannabis retailers

regulatory_exposure.value: high: cannabis cultivation, manufacturing and retail licenses from state cannabis regulators, plus federal controlled substance rules

notes: Exact state footprint and product mix may have changed; federal cannabis status is uncertain.
